scope: v31 local-only bytes, following the v29/v30 convention: regenerable contract, probe and regression CMake builds (both candidates), the contract's pending inputs (the v30 run's own later scans and poses), replay frames, the in-run MP4 duplicate of the tracked output copy, and the physical run's raw captures. Sources, scripts, logs (including scan.log), receipts, reviews and results are tracked.

regeneration.caches: Each enclosing run keeps request.json, inside.sh and its source (probe_source, breakdown_source, or refresh_probe_source with make_refresh_probe.py). Rerun it into a new directory against the named native tree in the pinned image sha256:f7363cc3deadc2419f3527a7b9ec7bdabaa3031fd8e1b9c6cc46666ae1301bbb; the versions/v31 manifest and runtime/scan64_input_refresh_v31/source_sha256.json fix the sources.
regeneration.pending: python3 versions/v31/input_refresh_contract/prepare_pending.py <experiment root> audits/2026-09-28_v30_stop_classes <new output dir> regenerates them from runs/v30_historical_full01 (sensor_manifest.json and artifacts/reactive_observations.jsonl, themselves local-only raw captures listed in versions/v30/LOCAL_ONLY_BYTES.json); pending_manifest.json (tracked) holds every file's SHA-256.
regeneration.frames: Rerun scripts/render_episode.py --source-run v31_historical_full01 through scripts/run_bounded.py. frames.json keeps per-frame hashes; the tracked MP4 is output/2026-09-27_lite3_versions/v31_historical_full_odom_stale.mp4.
regeneration.raw: Not regenerable. These are the recorded physical-run captures; preserve at the exact project paths.
